verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch runs as a headless server. The docs provide a scriptable one-liner (`curl -fsSL https://elastic.co/start-local | sh`) that sets it up in Docker for local development or testing, and official language clients support programmatic automation. Community users corroborate fully declarative, unattended deployments via the ECK operator and Kubernetes StatefulSets. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., CI service-container or test-harness guides), and evidence on non-trial licensing for the start-local setup, which ships with a one-month trial license.
